top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a distinct, mature and reproduced achievement with a clean two-name credit: at the magic wavelength the clock-transition light shift cancels, so many neutral atoms sit in the Lamb-Dicke regime with Doppler and recoil shifts suppressed and projection noise reduced. This differs in mechanism from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes, has been reproduced across JILA, RIKEN/Tokyo, PTB, SYRTE and NIST near 1e-18, and has already produced physics (centimetre-scale gravitational redshift, many-body clock effects, constant bounds). I keep the citation on invention and realisation, not on the SI redefinition or prospective applications. P002 (IceCube) is a real, unpredicted discovery and ranks second, though confirmation is internal to IceCube channels and the three-name cut is contestable; it still beats no award.
recusal_note: none apparent for P001 or P002 from profile; as WACQT director and a Chalmers superconducting-circuit theorist I have no known tie to the clock or IceCube candidates, though I share the Chalmers environment with Olsson and Mehlig.
